senses.gloss: pr. n. m.‘Ula (or ‘Ulla), name of several Amoraim.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 1:1:5">Y. Shek. I, beg. 45ᵈ</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:1:4">Y. Ber. II, beg. 4ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="P00566"><he>עילא</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 2:4:4">Y. Meg. II, 73ᵇ</cite> <he>עולה בירייה</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:7:12">Y. M. Kat. III, 83ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>ע׳ ביריא</he>; Bab.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 26a:23">M. Kat. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ ביראה</he>, v. <cite ref="B00701"><he>בֵּירָאָה</he></cite>.—
Y. Pes. III, 30ᵃ ע׳ דקיסרין; Y. Nidd. II, 50ᵃ bot.—Esp. known: ‘U. bar Yishmael, in Bab. only ‘Ula.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 5:6:6">Y. Gitt. V, 47ᵇ</cite> top; Bab.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 5:2:5">Y. Maasr. V, 51ᵈ</cite>, a. e. <cite ref="P00566"><he>עילא</he></cite>, <he>עילה</he>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3:15">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>ע׳ נחותא</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 12:3:15">Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="P00817"><he>עללא</he></cite> (corr. acc.), v. <cite ref="N00484"><he>נָחוֹתָא</he></cite>.—V. Fr. M’bo, p. 119ᵇ, sq.
